dogecoin.text: The real secret behind Dogecoin? In 2017, crypto insiders, including Jackson Palmer and Elon Musk, secretly manipulated the market. Using fake bots, they flooded social media with posts to create an illusion of hype. Musk’s playful endorsements were part of a coordinated pump.

The biggest secret of memecoins? In 2018, a prominent Dogecoin figure was secretly behind a pump-and-dump scheme that manipulated the price. The entire 'meme revolution' was part of a larger game, and most of us were just pawns. 💀💸

#MemecoinSecret #CryptoScandal #BehindTheMeme

The real secret of memecoins? In 2013, the creator of Dogecoin didn’t even expect it to survive a year. Yet here we are, with a market cap over $10 billion. The power of memes is not in their punchlines, but in the unpredictable belief people invest in them. 💡💸
